notes.title: Gamitate UI/UX revamp
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Gamitate has now an even friendlier User Interface. 
We listened to your suggestions and feedback and improved Gamitate accordingly.
If you're romanian you're in luck - you'll get to experience Gamitate in romanian.
We are starting to add voice over to improve Gamitate's immersion. Right now voice over is available for the english language.
Check out the new and improved Gamitate and let us know what you think! :)
(you can give feedback and join the community on discord: https://discord.gg/K7nJCPR5Ph )

notes.title: Gamitate Is Available Now On Steam!
notes.content:
Hello you beautiful people!

We've just released Gamitate on Steam. You can buy the game right now and start your meditation journey!


I want to thank my family, all the beta testers and specially YOU! 
You, the future and present Gamitate player. Without you Gamitate would not exist.

Gamitate is here to help you improve your mental well-being. 

It's here to improve your self-esteem. It's here to reduce your anxiety. It's here to reduce your depression. It's here to make you love and forgive yourself. 
[b]It's here to make your LIFE better! [/b]

Enjoy playing Gamitate and improving your mental well-being!

With love, 
Triple Cyclone Games.
